hero.title: Track your shipments
hero.subtitle: Trackora is an intelligent platform for shipment management, delivery tracking, and COD collection — designed for shipping companies, e-commerce stores, and delivery sellers in the Arab region.

demoCta.heading: Ready to start?
demoCta.text: Join thousands of companies managing shipments smartly with Trackora.

items.question: Is Trackora free?
items.answer: Yes, you can start free with a basic plan. Advanced plans are available for larger needs.

items.question: Does Trackora support Arabic?
items.answer: Absolutely. Trackora is Arabic-first — full interface, calendar, and number formatting.

items.question: How do I upload shipments?
items.answer: Upload individually or in bulk via Excel with smart validation and instant feedback.

items.question: How does COD collection work?
items.answer: Trackora manages the entire cash-on-delivery cycle — from customer collection to merchant settlement.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Absolutely. We use advanced encryption and never share your data. Your privacy is our priority.
